correctness.rationale: For all integer n, C_t(d) is equivalent by binomial finite differences to rational prime-adic congruence of Q_{d,t,c}(-1) for every c<d. Root-of-unity filtering yields Q=(-1)^c/c! times H with H=sum_{j>=1} (-d)^{jt} e_{c-jt}(1,...,c), so all infinite n quantifiers reduce exactly to finite integer valuation conditions at c=0..d-1. When t>=d, all sums vanish. Exhausting 2<=d<=36, 1<=t<=d yields upward closed valid order sets for d<=35 and at d=36 valid {15} union {17,18,...}; explicit c=32,t=16 rational witness is 196839814746004676662011581276685234/1506938033147421875 with v2=1<2 required, whereas all c<36 pass at t15. d1 trivial. This is a complete finite minimality proof not a heuristic extrapolation.
